checkpoint.initialization: All rows scratch; no teacher, no EMA, no external checkpoint
checkpoint.selection_rule: All24 fixed E200 controls frozen before target; no candidate filtering

execution.gpu_policy: Wait for existing stack and repair launch owners; <=4 new workers, <=2 total/GPU, >=12GB free. No interference with healthy experiments.
execution.stop_rule: Nonfinite loss/gradient, source or target permission violation, output collision or nonzero exit fails only affected row; no low-performance stop, automatic retry, fallback or unrelated intervention.

training wall time, CUDA peaks, inference seconds, model parameters
primary_endpoints: practical_mid_urban and practical_low_urban separately and equally weighted mean
each primary urban scene worst RX
secondary_endpoints: other4 fixed practical scenes; no target-based retuning
four paired seeds, mean/SD/per-seed signs; performance before cost

notes: User-fixed focus urban medium/low elevation. This is declared practical residual/noeq diagnostic study, not a default LEO_WEAK benchmark or real satellite validation.

Fast Trust/RC4 experience retained as conservative augmentation, clean retention and curriculum design reasoning; their actual routing, pseudo-labeling, quality calibration and additional losses are not enabled under current CE-only instruction.
No claim that bounded FIR guarantees fingerprint preservation: bound limits distortions; measured clean and unseen RX results determine validity.
U physical roles retained only for matched222 step budget, TX hidden and no U gradient.
Historical benchmark exposed. Fixed design driven by source/code and user scene request; target scores never select or retune.
Paired final tests use same physical query for clean and six diagnostic views. Phase2 K/support/adaptation/new classes N/A.
Healthy previous stack and repair controllers remain untouched; new controller waits for their actual exit.
Model performance and compute savings remain unproven until formal scoring. Negative results retained.

stage_policies.loss: CE clean + .68 satellite CE from E80; no consistency/teacher/pseudo/GRL/RC4 routing
stage_policies.budget: All24: E200x222=44400 optimizer updates, fixed final; cosine .0002 to .000001
stage_policies.receiver_dg: label-independent complex FIR: delays1,2,4; echo L1<=.15, 40epoch ramp, per-item p=.5, RMS preserved; no nonlinear TX perturbation
stage_policies.thinning: q=.5 independent satellite batch selection; importance2 retained CE; skip unused E1-79 branch. Actual reference model has no BatchNorm; stochastic trajectory changes, performance must be measured.
stage_policies.provenance: Scratch physical L/U/V exact6300/56700/27000; U unused by CE; V read-only; no Vcal/Vselect; no target-driven tuning
